versions.content: For receptions the TcpIp Module shall ignore the protocol checksum fields of frames with respect to the configuration of the Ethernet Controller according to the following list: a) for IPv4 frames if IPv4 checksum verifica tion in hardware is enabled, i.e. EthCtrlEnableOffloadChecksumIPv4 is set to TRUE b) for ICMP frames if ICMP checksum verification in hardware is enabled, i.e. EthCtrlEnableOffloadChecksumICMP is set to TRUE c) for TCP frames if TCP checksum verification in hard ware is enabled, i.e. EthCtrlEnableOffloadChecksumTCP is set to TRUE d) for UDP frames if UDP checksum verification in hardware is enabled, i.e. EthCtrlEnableOffloadChecksumUDP is set to TRUE. In all other cases, the TcpIp module shall treat frames with misma tching checksums according the related protocol specification.
